encodings.note: Save a restore-shadow-stack token on previous shadow stack.

exceptions.when: If the LOCK prefix is used. If CR4.CET = 0. IF CPL = 3 and IA32_U_CET.SH_STK_EN = 0. IF CPL < 3 and IA32_S_CET.SH_STK_EN = 0.

If SSP not 8 byte aligned. If alignment hole on shadow stack is not 0. If bit 1 of the previous-ssp token is not set to 1. If in 32-bit/compatibility mode and SSP recorded in previous-ssp token is beyond 4G. #PF(fault-code) If a page fault occurs.
The SAVEPREVSSP instruction is not recognized in real-address mode.
The SAVEPREVSSP instruction is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
If the LOCK prefix is used. If CR4.CET = 0. If CPL = 3 and IA32_U_CET.SH_STK_EN = 0. If CPL < 3 and IA32_S_CET.SH_STK_EN = 0.
If SSP not 8 byte aligned. If carry flag is set. If bit 1 of the previous-ssp token is not set to 1. #PF(fault-code) If a page fault occurs.
